subject: Re: ACME Health — GDPR DPA & SCC selection / controller-processor alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ella Simmons <ella.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: ACME Health — follow-up & next steps (DPA/SCC/controller-processor)

Hi Ella — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the asks we agreed on: 

1) Confirm ACME Health's desired role mapping (controller vs processor) for Redwood's services. From the call I heard ACME will act as the Controller and Redwood as the Processor — please confirm.

2) DPA: we'll provide our standard DPA for review. If you have any preferred clauses (data retention, deletion timelines, subprocessors) flag them up and we'll loop legal.

3) SCC selection: based on the role mapping, we'll propose the appropriate SCC annex/modules for controller-processor transfers — we'll include a short note on which module we recommend and why.

4) SOC 2 / security pack: attaching our security pack and DPA starter. Our SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA — if you'd like a copy we can get that to your legal team.

Next steps: I'll attach the DPA and security pack now. Can you confirm controller/processor roles and whether ACME prefers us to use your redline or apply our standard DPA? If you want us to send a DocuSign link, say the word and we'll prepare it.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf (DPA template), Redwood_Security_Pack_2027-03.zip (security summary, SOC 2 process overview, encryption/KMS info)

From: Ella Simmons <ella.simmons@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Randle <tom.randle@acmehealth.com>, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-03-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health — follow-up & next steps (DPA/SCC/controller-processor)

Thanks Marissa — good recap. Confirmations and a few questions from our side: 

- Role mapping: ACME Health will be the Controller; Redwood will be the Processor.
- DPA: we'd prefer to review your standard DPA first. Our legal team will likely provide a marked-up redline if anything needs to change.
- SCCs: can you advise which SCC module you'd recommend for a Processor providing model inference to a Healthcare Controller? Also confirm if you support the processor-to-controller obligations (e.g., assistance with data subject requests).
- SOC 2: we'd like to review the SOC 2 Type II report. We can execute an NDA.

Can you send the DPA and a DocuSign link once you have the version you'd like us to sign?

Best,
Ella
Head of Procurement
ACME Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ella Simmons <ella.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health — follow-up & next steps (DPA/SCC/controller-processor)

Hi Ella — great, thanks for confirming. A few quick answers: 

- Roles: noted (ACME = Controller, Redwood = Processor). We'll annotate the DPA accordingly.
- SCC recommendation: based on standard regulatory guidance for service providers processing EU personal data on behalf of healthcare controllers, we typically propose the Controller-to-Processor SCC module (i.e., the annex appropriate for controller-to-processor data transfers). We'll include a short SCC annex indicating the controller-processor relationship and the relevant obligations (e.g., subprocessors, audit cooperation, assistance with DSARs). If your legal team prefers a different module, we can discuss.

- SOC 2: our SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA. To speed things up, I'm including a security pack with summary controls and the SOC 2 request instructions. If you confirm an NDA, I'll route the SOC 2 to legal.

I've attached: Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf (our DPA draft) and Redwood_Security_Pack_2027-03.zip. If ACME would like a DocuSign-ready copy of the DPA, I can send that as the next step.

Rishi & Neha — FYI on the SCC module selection and SOC2 delivery. Any additional technical notes you want me to include for ACME's legal team?

Thanks — Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health — SCC annex suggestion / extra notes

Chiming in with a couple of suggestions for the legal thread: 

- SCC module: good call on the controller-to-processor annex. When we provide the SCC addendum, make sure it explicitly references that Redwood acts strictly as a Processor and lists subprocessors (we should attach the current subprocessors list as part of the security pack).

- DSARs & assistance: include explicit language that we will provide reasonable assistance for data subject access requests within the agreed timelines; identify the point of contact and SLAs for support requests.

- Remote audit / evidence: propose quarterly evidence snapshots (security pack) and an annual independent assessment (SOC 2 Type II). Note that full SOC 2 report will require NDA.

I'll pull an up-to-date subprocessors list and the SOC2 NDA template and drop them into the shared Drive link for ACME.

—Rishi

From: Ella Simmons <ella.simmons@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Randle <tom.randle@acmehealth.com>, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-03-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health — follow-up & next steps (DPA/SCC/controller-processor)

Marissa — thanks for the materials and notes. Legal will review the DPA and the SCC annex you propose. A couple of operational asks while we review: 

- Please send the SOC 2 Type II under NDA to legal@acmehealth.com (we'll coordinate NDA execution).
- Can you provide a DocuSign link to the current DPA so we can circulate internally if legal sign-off is straightforward?

- Timeline: we're aiming to finalize procurement and legal review by the end of the month (2027-03-31). If you can deliver the SOC2 under NDA and a DocuSign copy of the DPA by EOD 2027-03-24, that would keep us on track.

We'll follow up with any redlines. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Ella
Head of Procurement
ACME Health
